label: Restated-premise controls, checked
meaning: Closed controls for the restated-premise consolidation: the three registered equivalences hold by Iff.rfl over the stated carriers, and on one three-world frame with contingent concreta the three single-proposition grounding premises hold (P1-prime non-vacuously) while the universal Aristotelian grounding principle fails, so no one of them, and not their conjunction, entails the universal. The universal principle is satisfiable on the same frame. Model-witnessed only; a statement about these formal interpretations.
